title: Reel #3A — Brief wchodzi do Rady
hook: Rada nie odpowiada. Spiera się — żebyś ty przestał.
base_prompt:
Vertical 9:16 Instagram Reel. EXACTLY 15 seconds. Continuation of reel #2
(rada_polyphony_moj_swiat) — MATCH CUT from last frame: nine-face golden mandala.
Photorealistic dark mystical cinematic — deep blacks, warm gold #E8D5A3, teal shadows.
LOCKED CANON: agent portraits per agents_canon; do not redesign faces.

═══ STRATEGY ═══
Reel #2 introduced WHO. This reel shows WHAT HAPPENS — one brief enters the council,
four perspectives flash, Syez synthesizes. NOT a repeat of the 9×1.53s portrait montage.

═══ TIMELINE ═══
0.0–2.0s: Match cut — golden mandala from reel #2 end frame, ring pulses once.
Golden serif center text: „Rada nie odpowiada. / Spiera się — żebyś ty przestał.”

2.0–4.0s: At mandala center a luminous brief-block appears — abstract glowing text form,
illegible glyphs, only shape (no readable user data). Slow push-in.
Text: „Jeden brief. Dziewięć perspektyw.”

4.0–10.0s: From mandala nodes — FOUR quick portrait flashes (~1.5s each), NOT nine:
1 Kogit (Metatron cube, cold clarity) per agents_canon
2 Emojy (golden eyes, pre-verbal intensity) per agents_canon
3 Szow (split-face shadow, dignified) per agents_canon
4 Smaty (golden energy veins, somatic power) per agents_canon
Ken Burns to eyes; thin golden energy threads between flashes; soft overlapping ambient
tones (debate tension, not dialogue lip-sync).

10.0–13.0s: Mandala softens to bokeh; Syez portrait enters per agents_canon.Syez —
Merkaba chest glow, alchemical halo. Mirror consolidates four lights into one honest map.
Polish calm male voiceover (Syez, off-screen): „Nie wybieram za ciebie. Składam mapę napięć.”
Syez is NOT a tenth mandala node.

13.0–15.0s: Golden serif text:
„Twój brief. Ich debata. Twoja decyzja.”
Lower: Founders Cohort • link w bio

═══ SYEZ VOICEOVER (10.3–12.8s, Polish, calm, off-screen) ═══
Nie wybieram za ciebie. Składam mapę napięć.

═══ FORBIDDEN ═══
✗ Full nine-portrait montage repeat from reel #2 ✗ Name labels on faces
✗ Syez as tenth circle member ✗ Redesigning locked agent likeness

Identity — the Council of nine: nine DISTINCT inner faculties (intellect, shadow, child,
time, witness, relational, emotional, body, deep-diagnosis), held in tension, never merged.

Audio: Dynamic cinematic ambient: low drones building through four flashes, subtle percussive pulses on each perspective cut, warm pad under Syez voiceover, dignified fade at CTA..

Single unbroken cinematic shot. Color grade: deep navy shadows (#0A0D14), warm gold highlights (#C5A46E), teal accents (#3D8B8B). No text on screen. No jump cuts.
